intro: Westwood runs from the UCLA campus and Westwood Village south past Wilshire, where Westwood Boulevard turns into LA's best stretch of Persian food. The Village has historic movie palaces, late-night eats and the free Hammer Museum.

inf: The Infatuation: Where to eat in Westwood
